newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - OUB is "buy on weakness".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - OUB is "buy on weakness".

text.p: Overseas Union Bank Ltd (OUB) shares were given a "buy on weakness" recommendation on Monday by Fraser Securities after last week's news of higher profits and a rights issue to raise about Singapore $700 million.

"Weak market sentiment coupled with the size of the issue are likely to dampen OUB's share price in the short term. As such our recommendation is a buy on weakness," Frasers said in a note to clients.
It said OUB would be the fastest growing of Singapore's big four banks, but that earnings would grow at a slower rate than recently.
"The group is expected to see much slower earnings growth on average of 16 percent pa over the next two years compared with an average growth of 30 percent over the period 1993-1996," the note said.
"The recent one-for-five rights issue will raise the capital base by 20 percent, leading to considerable earnings dilution in the short term," it added.
OUB vice president of corporate planning, David Tan, told reporters he was "quite optimistic for the prospects for the bank," at its annual report news conference last week.
